brief:
# Build: agent-pick (Urgent profile)

Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice). Assigned agent: **Snap Sully** (book on his card when this starts; if he is still busy and the all-rounder router from crew-retrain #265 is on main, the router may give it to whoever is free - record who in the report). Register in Urgent (id `agent-pick`) + banner entry.

## What Brett wants
Every Claude session (voice/chat Amber, Claude Code, headless) runs AS an agent Brett assigns. Claude becomes whichever agent he picks.

## Build on what exists (don't duplicate)
- Console **Agent manager** plugin + **Agent swarm** page (agent cards: names, stats, pay $7.50/h, history, write-ups), AmberArt ID card art, crew-live (avatars, AgentAvatar component, agent context menu), follow-amber (console pop-up dialogs + axHub approval stream), claude-settings (Claude plugin, settings on axHub, `claude_settings_get`). Coordinate through their APIs; if one isn't on main yet, build against its contract and note it.

## Steps
- s1 **Assign hook:** in Agent manager, every agent row/card has 'Assign to Claude' (and the agent context menu gets it everywhere). Claude settings gets 'Claude agent' = default agent + 'Ask me every session' switch (default ON).
- s2 **Agent picker dialog**, opened from the context menu anywhere ('Choose Claude's agent...') and automatically at session start: list of every agent with avatar, name, status (working/idle), current job, today's cost, hours, pay, rating; tap a row to expand ALL details and stats (jobs done, success/fail, average cost and time, recent runs, write-ups, raises) with hooks to their full card, history, Session browser runs, Terminal tabs, group chat. One tap picks.
- s3 **Session-start approval:** when a Claude session starts it calls a new MCP tool `claude_session_start` {client: voice|chat|code|headless, summary}. With 'Ask me every session' ON, that pops the picker as a console approval dialog (via follow-amber's pop-up; also an axHub approval item as fallback, and a push to his phone). Until Brett answers, the session uses the default agent. The answer returns {agent id, name, persona/voice notes, avatar}. Headless builds keep their brief's named agent (no prompt) unless Brett turns on 'Ask for headless too'.
- s4 **Claude acts as that agent:** the session's work, costs and commits are booked on that agent's card (AXF_AGENT), its avatar shows on everything it does, and it introduces itself by that agent's name. Agent cards get an optional persona/voice field (how they talk) that the session follows. `claude_agent_get` (allow) tells a session who it is.
- s5 Rule in shared RULES.md + CLAUDE.md: 'Every Claude session calls claude_session_start first and works as the agent Brett assigns.' Commands declared once -> REST + MCP + CLI.
- s6 Zero tokens for the picker/manager code (no LLM imports, test). Tests (ask on/off, default fallback, booking to the right card, picker approval round trip with a fake axHub), phone + desktop screenshots, UI Review item, report `_claude/builds/reports/agent-pick.md`, THREADS, PR, steps through the store. Commits clean and professional.

Assign hook: 'Assign to Claude' on every Agent manager row/card and in the agent context menu; Claude agent + Ask me every session in Claude settings
Agent picker dialog: every agent with avatar, name, status, current job, today's cost, hours, pay, rating; one tap picks

Picker row expand: all stats (jobs, success/fail, avg cost/time, recent runs, write-ups, raises) + hooks to card, history, Session browser, Terminal tabs, group chat; 'Choose Claude's agent...' in the context menu

claude_session_start {client, summary}: ask on = console approval pop-up + axHub approval fallback + push; default agent until answered; returns {agent id, name, persona, avatar}; headless keeps brief agent unless 'Ask for headless too'
Claude acts as the agent: AXF_AGENT booking of session work/cost/commits on the card, avatar on its activity, claude_agent_get (allow)
